Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Washout time course for persistent chromatin marks (bimodal test)
ideas.description: Pulse cells with a defined AP-1 stimulus, wash it out, and track AP-1 site accessibility (ATAC-seq), H3K27ac, and AP-1 occupancy (CUT&RUN) at memory loci over days. A memory mechanism predicts that marks persist after stimulus removal and that the population splits into bimodal states rather than decaying smoothly, as a bistable switch would.

ideas.title: Degron-based necessity test during the silent interval
ideas.description: Use an auxin- or dTAG-inducible degron to deplete FOS or JUN only during the quiescent window after stimulation, then re-challenge and measure whether primed (faster or stronger) transcription of memory genes is lost. This separates AP-1 needed to maintain the memory from AP-1 needed only for the initial response.

ideas.title: Mitotic inheritance across cell divisions
ideas.description: Induce AP-1 transiently, sort cells by FACS at several generations after washout, and measure chromatin state and re-stimulation responses in daughter cells. Persistence through divisions, especially when AP-1 protein is absent, would indicate heritable self-maintained memory rather than a direct readout of ongoing AP-1 activity.

ideas.title: Dose-timing and delay-dependent recall assay
ideas.description: Pre-stimulate with varying doses and durations, then re-challenge after increasing delays and fit the decay of the primed response to estimate memory half-life and recall strength. Repeat with DNA-binding-deficient or site-mutant AP-1 at the memory enhancers; a memory mediated by AP-1 should be abolished or shortened in these mutants.

ideas.title: Single-cell lineage tracing of heterogeneous memory states
ideas.description: Combine a live AP-1 reporter with lineage barcoding and single-cell multiome sequencing to follow individual cells after stimulation, asking whether memory is retained in a subset of cells that shows a hidden, stable chromatin state. Such a state should be predictive of later responses, and its persistence should correlate with AP-1 occupancy at specific enhancers rather than with reporter signal alone.
